class.name: NetwControlRequest
class.brief_description: A request to control a node.
class.description: [NetwControlRequest] is emitted, in the server only, by [signal NetwEntity.control_requested] with one [NetwControlRequest] per request. The server may call [method deny] before the default grant path runs. [codeblock] func _on_control_requested(peer_id: int, request: NetwControlRequest) -> void: if not can_carry(peer_id): request.deny() [/codeblock] Writing [code]false[/code] to [member denied] commits the denial, subsequent writes have no effect.

members.member: Whether the request should be rejected. Writing [code]false[/code] over a [method deny] call has no effect.
The [enum NetwEntity.Hold] the peer asked to hold the entity with.
